name: contributors
title: People who have contributed data or curation to the database
description: One row per person. This table is the source of the author list on each citable Zenodo release: scripts/make_zenodo_metadata.py writes the `include_in_zenodo_authors` rows into .zenodo.json. Anyone who contributes a record is entitled to a row; a curator adds it if the contributor does not.

fields.name: contributor_id
fields.description: Stable slug, lowercase surname plus initial (e.g. stapley_j), suffixed on collision.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Family, Given — the form used in the Zenodo author list and in references.csv.

fields.name: orcid
fields.description: ORCID iD without the URL prefix. Optional: a contributor without one is still credited by name.

fields.name: role
fields.description: maintainer: runs the database. curator: reviews and merges submissions. contributor: supplied data.

fields.name: contributions
fields.description: What this person contributed, in words — map records, genome sizes, corrections, curation.

fields.name: first_release
fields.description: Release tag in which this person's contribution first appeared.

fields.name: include_in_zenodo_authors
fields.description: False only if the contributor has asked not to appear in the dataset author list.
